description: Ministry of Urban Development and Housing - Development Plan for the Pradeshiya Sabha Limit of Monaragala
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land and property-related matters, specifically the approval of a development plan for part of the Monaragala Pradeshiya Sabha limit. The content focuses on urban development planning and land use regulations under the Urban Development Authority Law, which falls under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land use planning and zoning changes. While it mentions a minister's name, this is incidental to the land development content and does not constitute a government personnel change or detailed portfolio description that would trigger a government-related classification.
